name: @dsh-agent/dsh-agent-memory
description: Agent-facing memory layer (increment 1, I1 foundation + I1.2 scoring calibration + I2 residual-pyramid triage): four narrow tools (remember/recall/expand/prune) over a human-readable NDJSON store with a fail-closed write protocol, atomic writes, hard caps with score-based eviction, and zero runtime dependencies. I1.2 scoring: BM25 with per-field statistics, absolute-scale display (no batch normalization), VCP-style tag coverage as a diagnostic column, and MMR diversity multiplied into the printed score. I2 triage: a Gram-Schmidt residual pyramid over the tag-idf lexical space (novelty = 0.7*residualRatio + 0.3*directionConsistency) decides whether recall widens kBase -> kExpanded; all pyramid state is request-local (no module-level cache), and low confidence is only reported, never used to veto.
